# Results of the port that differ from three.js 0.187.0 beyond 2 ulps,
# keyed `<group> op <index><path>`, each under a `##` heading that gives
# the cause. samples/three/tests/oracle.rs fails on a difference not
# listed here and on a listed one that no longer occurs.

## Chromium 147 rounds a near-tie of Math.cos the other way
# cos(-1.4277848129543687): the exact value lies 0.4948 ulp below
# 0.1425245265416519, the correctly rounded result (the port); Chromium
# returns the neighbour below, 0.14252452654165187.
# OrbitControls.update() computes it from the orbit angle, and the camera
# carries the 1-ulp difference forward; worldInverse's translation, a
# difference of nearly equal terms, shows it most.

orbit-15 op 6.worldInverse[13]
orbit-15 op 7.worldInverse[12]
